description: SELENE is a one-person project for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, tackling the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge. Using NASA's LOLA terrain data, JPL Horizons, and SPICE, SELENE transforms complex lunar science into an interactive platform to compare landing sites, explore solar illumination, visualize Sun and Earth positions, and assess potential communication windows. Our mission is to make lunar exploration more accessible, intuitive, and scientifically transparent.
